# Fixture — the Wound (F2 landed)

Small, synthetic stand-in for `docs/design/content/wound-spine.md` after PR #133: zone 3 is now
`Orndaeld`, and the rename note cites the retired name and the canon name in bold — the shape the
real document has at `wound-spine.md:188-189`.

## 4. Naming and derivations

| slug | Calethic | roots | status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vaelraeth` | **Vaelraeth** | *vaeld* + *raeth* | attested |
| `orndaeld` | **Orndaeld** | *orn* + *daeld* | coinage |
| `draekeld` | **Draekeld** | *drak* + *–eld* | coinage |

## 5. The rename

**Renamed 2026-11-20, and why the coin is a coin.** Zone 3 stood as **Orneld**, *orn* + *–eld*, which
is one letter from **Orveld**, the being's Calethic name — and a zone that reads as a typo of the
antagonist deflates the reveal the region is built on. The fix is not a letter moved: the name is
re-coined off *daeld* (what a structured thing leaves when it is undone) instead of *–eld* (site).
